roadmap.provenance: parsed from canonical roadmap Markdown (definitions + status sections)

phases.name: Phase 0
phases.title: Phase 0 -- Governance Foundation
phases.summary: Build the governance framework that allows autonomous software engineering to occur safely. - Governance architecture - Engineering handbook - Security policies - Development lifecycle - RFC process - ADR framework - Coding standards - Testing standards - Evidence standards - Audit logging - Release governance - Project dashboard HADA is capable of supervising engineering work safely. ---

phases.name: Phase 1
phases.title: Phase 1 -- Autonomous Engineering
phases.summary: Allow HADA to engineer software with minimal supervision. - GitHub integration - CI monitoring - Autonomous failure diagnosis - Autonomous repository inspection - Autonomous repair - Local verification - Regression detection - Evidence generation - Documentation updates - Draft PR generation - Continuous roadmap tracking HADA can autonomously: - Detect failures - Diagnose failures - Implement repairs

phases.name: Phase 2
phases.title: Phase 2 -- Hermes CTL
phases.summary: Build the personal AI operating environment. - User profile - Preferences - Context - Long-term memory - Working memory - Knowledge graph - Email - SMS - Telegram - Contacts - Calendar - Tasks - Notes - CRM - Files - Search - Knowledge management - Local LLM routing - Cloud fallback - Voice interface - Mobile interface Hermes CTL functions as a complete personal AI operating system. ---

phases.name: Phase 3
phases.title: Phase 3 -- Personal Intelligence
phases.summary: Enable proactive assistance. - Daily briefing - Planning - Smart reminders - Context awareness - Long-term memory - Relationship management - Shopping intelligence - Travel planning - Health tracking - Habit tracking - Financial awareness Hermes proactively assists without requiring continual prompting. ---

phases.name: Phase 4
phases.title: Phase 4 -- Home Hub Integration
phases.summary: Integrate household services while maintaining project separation. Implementation remains external to HADA and is governed through review and evidence. - Shopping - Inventory - Pantry - Calendar - Family tasks - Smart home - Cameras - Notifications - Dashboards - Household automation Home Hub integrates cleanly through governed interfaces. ---

phases.name: Phase 5
phases.title: Phase 5 -- Financial Intelligence
phases.summary: Develop governed financial assistance. - Budget engine - Spending analysis - Savings planning - Subscription management - Invoice OCR - Bill reminders - Investment tracking - Tax preparation support - Wise integration - Transaction reconciliation Hermes provides accurate financial guidance while maintaining human control over money movement. ---

phases.name: Phase 6
phases.title: Phase 6 -- Infrastructure
phases.summary: Operate primarily from local infrastructure with optional burst compute. - Local inference - GPU scheduling - Kubernetes - Vast.ai burst compute - RunPod burst compute - Backup automation - Monitoring - Secret management - Disaster recovery - High availability Hermes operates reliably from local infrastructure with governed cloud augmentation. ---

phases.name: Phase 7
phases.title: Phase 7 -- ADHD OS
phases.summary: Develop ADHD OS as a separate product. - Executive function tools - Routine management - Visual task planning - Motivation systems - Privacy-first architecture - Consent framework - Offline capability - Cross-platform support ADHD OS is independently deployable while remaining interoperable with Hermes. ---

phases.name: Phase 8
phases.title: Phase 8 -- Continuous Improvement
phases.summary: Never stop improving the ecosystem. - Code review - Refactoring - Technical debt reduction - Documentation improvements - Test improvements - Dependency updates - Security improvements - Performance optimisation - Model benchmarking - Tool evaluation - Architecture review --- For every iteration HADA shall: 1. Review roadmap. 2. Identify highest-priority unfinished task. 3. Verify prerequisites. 4. Implement one bounded change.
